_meta.status: Dispatch Engine v1. Only generatorReady conditions appear here.
_meta.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: every probability below is a seeded estimate, never NEMSIS or NTDB data.
rules: Every conditionId in this file must be generatorReady true in the repo medical data (oct28_conditions.json in v1). The validator rejects anything else.
coOccursWith: when this condition is drawn, also draw the listed conditions (if not already drawn).
excludes: when this condition is drawn, drop the listed conditions. V1 data has no exclusions; the sampler implements the rule and the headless test covers it with synthetic data.
onsetDelay_s: 0 in v1 (present at arrival). Delayed-onset conditions such as tension pneumothorax need engine support and land with the Nov 2 conditions.

Medical mappings are honest placeholders: the fleshed narrative carries the toxidrome or cardiac or allergy story while the engine instantiates only modeled trauma physiology. Each mapping says so in its note.
